ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited has successfully secured a 300 MW (1.2 GWh) 'Assured Peak Power' project from SECI at a tariff of Rs. 6.00/kWh, significantly expanding its PPA-signed Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) pipeline to approximately 15 GWh. This win demonstrates ACME's competitive strength in the hybrid renewable energy sector, with existing land and connectivity expected to expedite project execution; however, the explicit note that this is a "voluntary submission" not under Regulation 30 suggests the deal may not yet be a fully binding, material contract.
